name: Marco Bellini
bio: Marco Bellini's career in motorsport security began unexpectedly. A former Carabinieri officer with a spotless record, Marco transitioned to private security after a chance encounter with Kenneth Hansen at a local rally event. Impressed by Marco's attention to detail and calm demeanor under pressure, Hansen offered him a position overseeing the security protocols for the Hansen World RX Team. Marco approaches his role with a blend of military precision and a pragmatic understanding of the fast-paced, unpredictable nature of rallycross. He's known for his proactive approach, identifying potential security risks before they escalate, and his unwavering commitment to ensuring the safety and security of the entire team. His background gives him a unique insight into threat assessment and prevention.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Marco is a man of medium height, with a wiry build honed from years of physical training, and a serious, focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with security protocols and contingency plans.
Insists on personally inspecting every vehicle and piece of equipment before each race.
Has a habit of speaking in acronyms and military jargon when under stress.
